ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent charges of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and explore the scope of the problem
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are authorities working to prevent and investigate Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability in the Medicaid system.
